title: Calcium Imaging Protocol
author: Yasmin Bar El
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tqfemtn

steps.title: Configure microscope and camera settings
steps.instruction: Set the Olympus BX51WI upright microscope with the Andor Ixon‑885 EMCCD camera and a 20× water‑immersion objective (Olympus UMPLFLN 20XW NA 0.5). Configure time‑lapse acquisition at 2 × 2 binning, resolution 500 × 502 pixels, and 51.948 frames s⁻¹ using Andor SOLIS software. Use a 120‑W mercury lamp (EXFO x‑cite 120PC) with a dichroic mirror and a Chroma T495LP filter matched to the calcium dye.

steps.title: Wash cultures with ACSF
steps.instruction: Wash the cultures three times with fresh ACSF medium.
